audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 read Teemo or Skill while whys[1] through whys[5], the early block and the mid block all say Maokai owns that entire stretch. The page also rates the lane 8.5/10 difficulty and colours it red, while stating 'You hold the straight 1v1 all game' and winning 57.45%.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Maokai x5 / Skill. Teemo has no dash, and Twisted Advance is a targeted dash he cannot dodge — the mirror settled that. His threat is the late map, not the lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Maokai with matched content pairs and ratings; difficulty moved from 8.5/10 to 5.5/10, tone from red to amber, and the final rating line from 'Hard' to 'Even'. Row 6 left as Teemo — whys[6] and spikes[3] both describe his scaling correctly.

audit.why: Four spikes present: the 2-3 root window, level-6 Nature's Grasp against his kite, the first-item sustain spike, and his late shroom/splitpush scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d tell you to 'sapling-poke instead' when Blinding Dart is up, implying the blind shuts your trade down. It only blanks basic attacks.
audit.why: Riot's Q text blinds the target — Bramble Smash, Sapling Toss, Twisted Advance's root and Nature's Grasp all still land. Blinding Dart is a flat 7s, Move Quick 14s, and Move Quick's passive speed drops the moment a champion strikes him. Twisted Advance is targeted at 525, so it cannot be sidestepped.
audit.corrected: Blind-vs-spells rule and the real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: The late block already states the real win condition — close the lane before his shrooms and splitpush matter, and clear brush near objectives.

edits.before: His blind + %HP + kite — build MR, W-root his kite. Maokai wins the Blinding Dart cooldown windows.
edits.after: Blinding Dart (7s) blanks your autos, never your spells — W-root through it, Q-knockback, then auto.

edits.before: Blinds your autos. Sapling-poke instead. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The blind stops autos only — W and Q still land, so root first and auto after it ends.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos. Sapling-poke instead. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart (7s): blanks autos, not spells — W-root and Q straight through it. - Move Quick (14s) is his only disengage, and a targeted Twisted Advance beats it. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: Rows 1-5 proposed as one atomic group across both layers.
